translated_title: Sheinbaum Reaffirms Invitation for Pope Leo XIV to Visit Mexico, in Meeting With Cardinal Pietro Parolin
original_title: Sheinbaum ratifica invitación al Papa León XIV para que visite México, en encuentro con el cardenal Pietro Parolin
author: Alma E. Muñoz and Enrique Méndez
meta_description: Sheinbaum met Cardinal Parolin at the National Palace and tied her invitation to Pope Leo's encyclical on AI regulation, a debate she says Mexico is also waging.
